title: The History Is the Detector: Executing CVE Patch History, End-to-End
abstract: arXiv:2609.05335v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Public vulnerability databases collect rich information about known software flaws, including their weakness types, affected components, and related patches. Fixing commits provide the exact code changes that removed these flaws. While these records capture why the original code was unsafe, they are documented mainly for human inspection rather than automated reuse. Consequently, the same unsafe conditions may still exist elsewhere in code without a known advisory, leaving much of this detection knowledge unused.   We present BUGSTONE-E2E, a framework that transforms vulnerability history into executable detection rules and validates their findings. First, BUGSTONE-E2E mines reusable rules from verified fixing commits, capturing scan anchors, fix semantics, and CVE provenance and organizing them by CWE and language. Second, detection follows a funnel-shaped pipeline: early stages process a large pool of candidates using lightweight ana

translated_title: 历史即检测器：端到端执行CVE补丁历史
translated_abstract: 公开的漏洞数据库收集了关于已知软件缺陷的丰富信息，包括其弱点类型、受影响的组件以及相关补丁。修复提交（fixing commits）提供了移除这些缺陷的确切代码变更。虽然这些记录说明了原始代码为何不安全，但它们主要是供人工审查而非自动化重用。因此，同样的不安全条件可能仍然存在于代码中没有已知公告的其他位置，导致大量此类检测知识未被利用。我们提出了BUGSTONE-E2E，这是一个将漏洞历史转化为可执行检测规则并验证其发现的框架。首先，BUGSTONE-E2E从经验证的修复提交中挖掘可重用规则，捕获扫描锚点、修复语义和CVE溯源信息，并按CWE类型和编程语言进行组织。其次，检测遵循漏斗形流水线：早期阶段使用轻量级分析处理大量候选对象。
tldr: BUGSTONE-E2E框架通过从CVE修复提交中挖掘按CWE和语言组织的可执行检测规则，并采用漏斗形流水线进行端到端检测，将漏洞补丁历史转化为可自动化复用的漏洞检测能力。
en_tdlr: BUGSTONE-E2E transforms CVE patch history into executable detection rules by mining reusable rules from verified fixing commits organized by CWE and language, and validates findings through an end-to-end funnel-shaped detection pipeline.
